THE PROJECT

Exploration of Tunis

A personal place tracker for exploring Tunisia. I use it to remember where I have been, record my own ratings, and decide what to revisit or try next.

Why I built it

I built it to remember the places I visit in Tunisia and whether they are worth revisiting.

My contribution

I created this tool for my own exploration of Tunisia: a place to keep visited locations and personal ratings together.
